units.source_text: 舞乐之事，自不必说，早已准备周妥。

en.t: As for the music and dancing, needless to say, everything had long since been thoroughly prepared.

units.source_text: 红日西倾之时，开始表演《春莺啭》[\[3\]](#part1337.html#m3)，

en.t: When the red sun was sinking toward the west, the performance of Spring Orioles Singing began,

units.source_text: 歌声舞态，无不十分美妙。

en.t: and both the singing voices and the movements of the dance were exquisitely beautiful.

units.source_text: 皇太子回忆去秋红叶贺时源氏公子所演《青海波》，

en.t: The Crown Prince recalled the Blue Sea Waves that Lord Genji had performed at the autumn maple celebration the previous year,

units.source_text: 便赏赐他樱花一枝插于冠上，恳切地劝他表演。

en.t: so he bestowed on him a branch of cherry blossoms to place in his cap and warmly urged him to perform.

units.source_text: 盛情难却，源氏公子便起立出场，

en.t: Unable to refuse such gracious insistence, Lord Genji rose and stepped out into the performing space,

units.source_text: 从容举袖，表演一节，聊以应命。

en.t: then calmly lifted his sleeves and performed one brief passage, merely to comply with the request.
The beauty of his bearing was beyond compare.

units.source_text: 左大臣看了，浑忘旧恨，感动流泪。

en.t: The Minister of the Left watched him, completely forgot his old resentment, and was moved to tears.
Then he asked, "Where is the Captain?

units.source_text: 头中将也就挺身而出，表演一出《柳花苑》舞。

en.t: The Captain also promptly stepped forward and performed a dance from Willow Blossom Garden.
It lasted rather long, and his technique was refined and detailed.

units.source_text: 想是预知如此，早有准备，姿态十分美妙。

en.t: Perhaps he had foreseen this and prepared in advance, for his movements were wonderfully graceful.
The Emperor immediately awarded him a robe from the imperial wardrobe.

units.source_text: 人皆以为此乃特殊恩典，甚可珍贵。

en.t: Everyone regarded this as a special favor and considered it extremely precious.

units.source_text: 此后诸公卿不按顺次出场献舞；

en.t: After that, the various nobles came out to offer dances without following the proper order;

units.source_text: 但日色已昏，灯光之下不辨巧拙。

en.t: but by then the daylight had already faded, and under the lamplight no one could distinguish skill from clumsiness.
